4753-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enters as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

247-2390-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
247-2390-6191.description:
Gain life.
Twinblade Paladin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1680-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1680-4881-6909-7884.easyPrerequisites: Runed Stalactite is attached to Carnage.
1680-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

985-5078-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5147-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5147-5254-7741.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3179-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1429-4981-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6138.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Bloodboil Sorcerer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1525-5751-6504-7753.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

198-2585-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn has at least three charge counters on it.
198-2585-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by paying {4}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
198-2585-3918.notes: Once you have extra mana, Grim Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

3054-3416-5670-7399.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-5670-7399.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Bogwater Lumaret triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1558-1671-2638-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-4321.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

703-3497-7012.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
703-3497-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying at most {4}{U}{U} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 2.
703-3497-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

1020-2866-5060-5231.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card and a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1020-2866-5060-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.

1018-1692-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1018-1692-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1018-1692-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder with haste.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

4766-5686-6990.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-4676-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-4211-4708-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-4211-4708-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Squirrel by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

539-2292-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2593-4067-4823-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

56-1417-5075-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-5075-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

465-1115-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1115-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1247-4188-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Accomplished Alchemist and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-4188-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2845-3556-3584-4423.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
You control at least four Islands.
2845-3556-3584-4423.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Flicker at least once, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the first copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Any remaining copies of Flicker fizzle due to having no legal target.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Quintorius Kand and Thousand-Year Storm trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Flicker at least twice, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 3.
You may optionally target any permanent using the additional Flicker copies to blink them.

1684-2178-2438-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
1684-2178-2438-2757.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-2966-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites: Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2966-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Zopandrel by paying {2} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least one additional permanent as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

262-2584-3332.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible.
262-2584-3332.description:
Give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible, if needed.
Activate Deep-Slumber Titan by tapping it, creating seven 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve all remaining Pandemonium triggers, dealing 6 damage divided among any number of targets.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3062-3490-3517-4868.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2060-3062-3490-3517-4868.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer, causing you to pay {2} to put four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers four times.
Resolve the first three Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
